name: burrau_2x
source: docs/design/principia_chart_reference.md § 4.2 Positions and masses — Burrau convention, at (m, n) = (2, 1), the (3, 4, 5) triangle
masses: normalised (5,4,3)/12: each mass equal to its opposite side over a + b + c (chart_reference §4.2), not the historical (3,4,5)
construction: §4.2's hypotenuse-normalised positions r0 = (0, 0), r1 = (a/c, 0), r2 = (0, b/c) have I = 1/5 in their CoM frame; rescaled by √5 to I = 1, then doubled: r = 2√5·r(§4.2), so I_in = 4 = 4·I_canon and λ = I_in^(−1/2) = 1/2. Released from rest (p = 0). The origin stays at body 0, off the CoM, so step 1a has work to do. Values are f64 decimals.
